      "evidence": "Traced path in the reviewed tree: delegation/dispatch_phase.go:667 passes `Root: s.root, SettingsFile: s.settingsPath()`. dispatch/build.go:443 calls `admittedRequest(p.LookupEnv, p.Root, p.Runtime, permissions)`, ignoring p.SettingsFile. dispatch/codexsandbox.go:37-44 opens Root/metasystem.conf, where the worktree's tracked file has no launch.codex.sandbox, so it uses the default workspace-write and the request is not widened. adapter/codex.go:189-200 (CodexAdmittedSandbox) returns workspace-write without widenedBy, and supervisor/codex.go:165 launches the job round with that mode.       "title": "One dispatch-path settings reader still reads the goal worktree's metasystem.conf: the Codex sandbox admission.
